content_md: Slowly emerging from yet another rabbit hole of tool building. Productive Procrastination never felt so enticing, yet it also yields more results than ever. I think the term “Productive Procrastination” might not age that well in the near future. Getting lost on satisfying side tracks may have been a recipe for failure on the main quest. But what if the environment changed, from linear RPG towards procedural sandbox builder?
